tools.name: current_date
tools.description: Get the current date and local time in Europe/Madrid. Free; evaluated live for every call. Example: call it with no arguments to get today's date and time in Madrid.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the Vextorium catalog of 242 paid data services by keywords (e.g. 'crypto price', 'sanctions', 'ECB rates', 'earthquakes'). Free. Returns service ids, descriptions and prices. Example: query='ECB rates', limit=5 returns the 5 closest services with their prices.

tools.name: service_details
tools.description: Details of one Vextorium service: what it does, its price in USDC, the JSON input it accepts (schema) and an example. Free. Example: service='ecb-rates-history' returns its price, input schema and a sample body.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Run any Vextorium service with its parameters and get the JSON result. Paid per call in USDC via x402 (price shown by service_details); invalid input, or a failed upstream source with no current data held, is not charged. Example: service='ecb-rates-history', params={"date": "2024-06-14", "from": "E

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "current_date" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
